skill.name: agy-worker
skill.description: Delegate bounded repository exploration and implementation to Google Antigravity CLI with explicit transmission approval, worktree controls, verification, and Codex review.
skill.summary: Run controlled Antigravity repository jobs, then review their changes and evidence in Codex.
skill.author: cagdasyurekli

security_audit.summary: Most reviewed matches are false positives from documentation, schemas, validation literals, fixed Git commands, and type annotations. Confirmed risks are provider execution, approved verifier execution, legacy shell verification, selected environment forwarding, and opt-in access to Antigravity user settings. No prompt injection or exfiltration intent was found, but 565 capped static matches still require manual review before automatic publication. Static review was capped at 400/965 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 565 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Legacy verification executes a free-form string through Bash.
remediation.suggestion: Remove legacy shell verification or require canonical argv arrays with no shell interpretation.

remediation.issue: Provider and verifier processes can execute repository tooling with granted host authority.
remediation.suggestion: Default to native containment where supported, restrict executable paths, enforce timeouts, and require explicit approval for every environment value.

remediation.issue: Account diagnostics read Antigravity settings from the user home directory.
remediation.suggestion: Keep this action opt-in, read only documented permission fields, and redact all output before logs or reports.

remediation.issue: Static review was capped at 400 of 965 matches.
remediation.suggestion: Manually review the remaining 565 matches and repeat adjudication without a cap before automatic publication.

content.value_statement: Large repository tasks can require coordinated exploration, implementation, and verification. This skill delegates controlled work to Antigravity while Codex retains review and delivery authority.
actual_capabilities: Launch Antigravity CLI jobs for repository exploration, implementation, and project work.
Require explicit approval for scoped or whole-worktree provider transmission.
Create disposable worktrees, private job state, verification copies, and evidence receipts.
Run structured verification commands and optional legacy shell checks.
Resume, continue, restart, cancel, inspect, and finalize delegated jobs.
limitations: It requires Codex, Bash, Python, Git, Antigravity CLI, provider authentication, and network access.
Session isolation does not provide host containment for the Antigravity process.
Provider and verifier commands can access resources granted to their processes.
It cannot replace independent diff review, testing, security review, or release approval.

use_cases.title: Explore an unfamiliar repository
use_cases.description: Map architecture, dependencies, tests, and relevant files before planning a change.

use_cases.title: Implement a scoped repair
use_cases.description: Delegate a bounded fix, then inspect the worktree diff and focused verification evidence.

use_cases.title: Coordinate project delivery
use_cases.description: Manage multi-cycle implementation with explicit approvals, job state, quality gates, and independent acceptance.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this repository. Identify the architecture, relevant files, current tests, and key risks. Do not edit files.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a bounded change
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this change. Identify the smallest affected scope, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and verification steps. Do not implement it.

prompt_templates.title: Implement and verify
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement this change within the approved scope. Run relevant checks, summarize the diff, and report every unresolved failure.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a project workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute this project through bounded cycles. Preserve evidence, verify the candidate, and prepare a concise report for independent acceptance.

output_examples.input: Map the authentication flow without editing files.
output_examples.output: The report identifies authentication entry points, configuration sources, related tests, data flow, and unresolved review areas.

output_examples.input: Add the requested validation and run focused tests.
output: The validation changed only approved files.
Focused tests passed in the verification copy.
The handoff lists changed files and remaining assumptions.

output_examples.input: Verify the completed job for final review.
output_examples.output: The handoff presents the candidate digest, verification result, change summary, and unresolved warnings for Codex review.

best_practices: Approve the smallest repository content and write scope needed for the task.
Remove secrets and unrelated private files before any provider transmission.
Review the complete diff, receipts, and independent checks before accepting changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use whole-worktree transmission when scoped staging can complete the task.
Do not treat provider success or worker prose as proof of correctness.
Do not pass credentials to provider or verifier environments without explicit need and approval.

faq.question: What does this skill delegate?
faq.answer: It delegates approved repository exploration, implementation, and project workflows to Antigravity CLI.

faq.question: Which AI host is supported?
faq.answer: Codex is the supported host. Claude and Claude Code are not supported runtimes for this skill.

faq.question: Can it modify my repository?
faq.answer: It can modify files inside an approved disposable worktree when the selected workflow permits edits.

faq.question: What can reach the provider?
faq.answer: Approved scoped files or the entire approved disposable worktree can reach Google or Gemini.

faq.question: Does session mode isolate the host?
faq.answer: No. Session mode gives Antigravity the normal filesystem and network authority of the current user.

faq.question: How should results be accepted?
faq.answer: Inspect the exact diff, run independent checks, review receipts, and resolve warnings before final acceptance.
